summary: Killenaule-born husband of Catherine Neagle and father of Thomas Heffernan of Lanespark; once shown as John's ancestor, but not of John's line.
bio: Patrick Heffernan is recorded as born at Killenaule, County Tipperary, on 15 March 1763 and as dying at Lynn, Massachusetts, on 3 September 1871; a life of 108 years means that at least one of those dates is wrong. With his wife Catherine Neagle he was the father of Thomas Heffernan of Lanespark, baptized in 1791, who married Catherine Shelly in 1831. He was once shown as the father of John's ancestor Thomas Heffernan of Mardyke, but the history of the Heffernans of Slieveardagh shows that these were two different families with no proven link between them, so Patrick is not John's ancestor.
sources: Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)
